fusions.name: Bitter Draught
fusions.desc: Fires a draught that deals 15 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Back in Their Cups
fusions.desc: Spills drawn poison around you, dealing 4 poison damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. You heal for 8% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Purging Toast
fusions.desc: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and every ally, and restores 8 health to you.

fusions.name: Cast-Iron Stomach
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you carry 15% poison resistance.
